PvP is the Eisner and Harvey award-winning webcomic created by Scott Kurtz. PvP has run online for over 24 years, garnered the love and support of hundreds of thousands of daily readers, been printed in TWO languages, published by Image Comics, and has almost been an animated series.
Scott can be found hiding from the coronavirus in the Pacific Northwest but occasionally leaves his studio to enjoy the dog park or visit his family.

Over the last two decades, I’ve written and drawn a lot of comics and I felt it was time for all of it to live in one place. This is that place. Toonhoundstudios.com is the new home of PvP, Table Titans, Mort, and all of the other odds and ends I plan to make in the years to come.
